title: Adoption of Categorical Exclusions from the Tennessee Valley Authority Under the National Environmental Policy Act
action: Notice of adoption of multiple Categorical Exclusions from the Tennessee Valley Authority.
abstract: The Export-Import Bank of the United States (EXIM) is adopting multiple categorical exclusions (CEs) from the agencies as listed: Tennessee Valley Authority CEs 49 and 50. This notice identifies the categories of proposed actions and describes the consultation between the agencies.
